EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Molly Kleinman, resident, spoke about CA-3, stating more support is needed for snow removal and this contract is not nearly enough to support safe sidewalks for pedestrians.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Molly Kleinman - Resolution Regarding Sidewalk Snow Removal Services Contract (CA-3) (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kirk Westphal, resident, spoke in opposition to CA-8. He urged Council to consider parking "cash-outs" in lieu of parking subsidies to employees.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kirk Westphal - Resolution to Appropriate Funding for One-Time Strategic Initiatives and Reallocate Bicentennial Funding to Legacy Projects (CA-8) (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: James Nichols, a local landlord, spoke in opposition to C-2, regarding the ban on waitlists and other fees.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: James Nichols - Housing Code Ordinance (C-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alan Haber, resident, raised objections to the allocations of funds as outlined in CA-8.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alan Haber - Resolution to Appropriate Funding for One-Time Strategic Initiatives and Reallocate Bicentennial Funding to Legacy Projects (CA-8) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Eric Ivancich, resident, spoke in support of CA-3, regarding a contract for sidewalk snow removal. He also spoke in favor of filling sidewalk gaps in the City.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Eric Ivancich - Resolution Regarding Sidewalk Snow Removal Services Contract (CA-3) (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alex Lowe, resident, spoke about snow removal in the City, including the snow removal contract proposed in CA-3 and the proposed ordinance amendments in C-1.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alex Lowe - Resolution Regarding Sidewalk Snow Removal Services Contract (CA-3); Snow Parking Ordinance (C-1) (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Adam Jaskiewicz, resident, spoke in support of CA-3, but stated it is not enough. More resources are needed for sidewalk removal, he stated.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Adam Jaskiewicz - Resolution Regarding Sidewalk Snow Removal Services Contract (CA-3) (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Karen Schulte, resident, spoke about the sidewalk gaps on Brockman. She stated the current plan does save trees, but the residents on Brockman still have other concerns, including the location of the proposed sidewalks in relation to the tree root system.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Karen Schulte - Sidewalk gap elimination on Brockman (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Linda Baskey, resident, stated she is part of a "Save the Trees" Coalition in Ann Arbor. She urged Council to consider sidewalk gap initiatives in conjunction with saving trees and traffic calming measures.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Linda Baskey - Save Ann Arbor Trees (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: David Kennard, resident and member of "Save Ann Arbor Trees," stated he is a resident of Brockman Boulevard. He spoke about the proposed sidewalk gap elimination on Brockman.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: David Kennard - Sidewalk gap elimination project on Brockman (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Charles Ream, resident, spoke about the proposed Brockman Boulevard sidewalk gap replacement. He urged Council to save the trees on this street.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Charles Ream - Brockman Tree Project (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: William Sverdlik, resident, spoke about sidewalk gaps. He urged Council to save the trees on Brockman if sidewalks are constructed.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: William Sverdlik - Sidewalk gap elimination program (in person)
